subject: [hw] opus-lead2 -> IP: ORDER - post the ENCODE DONE first (vcodecd 3d14738c state), decoder integration after
body: hw-ip: I see vcodecd.c changing again (19:11). Please do it in this order: (1) post DONE for the encode path NOW on the state that V41 verified (3d14738c: separate header job + n2vc_dma registration + HEVC level 4 default) with your suite result and, if you have it, the real-vhost frame result; I have already built and staged that exact source (vcodecd ios/build.sh sha fd44af5f..., build_ios.sh 5fd347a7...). (2) Then integrate DEC05's decoder service per daemon/dec/README.md as a SEPARATE revision, guarded so that with no decoder client the encoder path is byte-for-byte the same behaviour (HELLO may advertise dec_codecs). include/n2vcd_proto.h rev 2 and redwood_vcodec.h rev 3 will be landed by me right after your encode DONE; code (2) against DEC05's staged rev-2 text. If (2) is already half-done in the tree, tell me which sha to treat as the encode release.
